extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md notes possible overlap with mauri_2024 (shared Italian investigators) but judged unlikely due to different population (controlled ventilation vs pressure support) and period. No trial registration number or enrolment dates reported to compare.
unclear_items: Age discrepancy: Results text reports '61 years old (52–71 yr old)' but Table 1 reports 'Age (yr) 63 (53–72)'. Recorded Table 1 value.
PEEPPL titration target: The exact numeric range for end-expiratory PL from the sliding table is not reported; only narrative 'slightly above zero' and end-inspiratory limit below 25 cm H2O.
Survival rate in Table 1: 'Survival rate 12/20 (60%)' listed as baseline characteristic; timepoint not defined.
Balloon inflation volume not reported; only 'inflated as recommended by the manufacturer'.
Country inferred from hospital locations (Ferrara, Milan, Italy).
extraction_flags.general_notes: Study reports no clinical outcomes (mortality, ventilator-free days, length of stay). It is purely physiologic. No between-group effect estimates are reported; paired analysis is within-patient crossover. The EIT-guided method is a comparator of interest, not standard care.
